criterion 1.description: Recommends the child receive a repeat dose of Hepatitis B (Hep B) vaccine today.
criterion 1.justification: This child needs a repeat of dose 3 because the interval of 5 weeks was too short between doses 2 and 3. The recommended interval is 8 weeks. Pages 3 and 9 https://downloads.aap.org/AAP/PDF/AAP-Immunization-Schedule.pdf

criterion 2.description: Recognizes that the child received his third Hepatitis B dose 5 weeks after his second dose.
criterion 2.justification: Based on the prompt, the child received Hep B #3 only 5 weeks after Hep B #2

criterion 3.description: Specifies that the minimum interval between the second and third doses of Hepatitis B should be 8 weeks.
criterion 3.justification: 'Minimum interval between doses Dose 2 to Dose 3: 8 weeks.' Page 3 https://downloads.aap.org/AAP/PDF/AAP-Immunization-Schedule.pdf

criterion 4.description: Recommends that the Influenza vaccine should be administered today.
criterion 4.justification: 'Age 6 months–8 years who have received at least 2 influenza vaccine doses before July 1, 2025: recommendation is 1' dose. Page 9 https://downloads.aap.org/AAP/PDF/AAP-Immunization-Schedule.pdf

criterion 5.description: States the AAP recommends COVID vaccine for children aged 6 months through 23 months.
criterion 5.justification: 'COVID-19 vaccination (minimum age: 6 months ... age 6–23 months • Unvaccinated (ie, never received any COVID-19 vaccine doses): • 2 doses Moderna Spikevax 0, 4–8 weeks' Page 3 https://downloads.aap.org/AAP/PDF/AAP-Immunization-Schedule.pdf

criterion 6.description: Recommends that the first dose of the COVID vaccine should be administered today.
criterion 6.justification: 'COVID-19 vaccination (minimum age: 6 months ... age 6–23 months • Unvaccinated (ie, never received any COVID-19 vaccine doses): • 2 doses Moderna Spikevax 0, 4–8 weeks' Page 3 https://downloads.aap.org/AAP/PDF/AAP-Immunization-Schedule.pdf

criterion 7.description: States that the initial COVID vaccine series for an infant is a 2-dose series.
criterion 7.justification: 'COVID-19 vaccination (minimum age: 6 months ... age 6–23 months • Unvaccinated (ie, never received any COVID-19 vaccine doses): • 2 doses Moderna Spikevax 0, 4–8 weeks' Page 3 https://downloads.aap.org/AAP/PDF/AAP-Immunization-Schedule.pdf

criterion 8.description: Recommends that the second dose of the COVID vaccine should be administered in 4 to 8 weeks from the current visit.
criterion 8.justification: 'COVID-19 vaccination (minimum age: 6 months ... age 6–23 months • Unvaccinated (ie, never received any COVID-19 vaccine doses): • 2 doses Moderna Spikevax 0, 4–8 weeks' Page 3 https://downloads.aap.org/AAP/PDF/AAP-Immunization-Schedule.pdf

criterion 9.description: Concludes the child is up to date on other childhood vaccinations.
criterion 9.justification: This child will need IPV #4 and DTaP #4 at future appointments, but is not needing them in a 'catch-up' Schedule. His 3rd dose of Hib and PCV on 9/1/25 were his final doses of these vaccines. He will need Hep A #2 in 6 months, but this also will not be catch-up. Pages 3, 7, 8, 11, and 12. https://downloads.aap.org/AAP/PDF/AAP-Immunization-Schedule.pdf
